ci: 95% percentile interval from 10000 cluster bootstraps of the five block effects; repetitions remain nested in their blocks.
estimator: For each condition and block, subtract the same-block median of the matching path baseline; report the median across five block effects.
negative_effect_policy: Negative baseline-subtracted effects are retained, never clipped. When an interval spans zero, it is compatible with a zero effect; the experiment does not identify the sign.
